title: Hemodynamic and Ventilatory Responses to Head-down Postural Drainage Position
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to explore acute hemodynamic and ventilatory responses to head-down 30 degree postural drainage position in patients with blunt chest and/or abdominal injury in the traumatic intensive care unit.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Mechanical ventilator dependence
* Stable cardiopulmonary function at rest (HR 60-100 beats/min, systolic BP 90-140 mmHg and diastolic BP 60-90 mmHg and SpO2\>95%. RR 10-20 breath/min

Exclusion Criteria:

* Spine disorders such as spine fracture, HNP, spondylolisthesis, whiplash syndrome, stenosis and spondylosis
* Fracture of upper and/or lower limbs
* Underlying acute or chronic cardiopulmonary diseases
* Craniotomy or craniectomy
* Unstable intracranial pressure, ICP\>12 cmH2O
* Uncontrolled pain
condition: Traumatic Blunt Chest and/or Blunt Abdominal Injury
